lines.label: Change
lines.note: Instated AFK/Leaver detections and punishments.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: After 70 seconds of inactivity, the AFK warning will appear on the player's screen.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Issuing move, attack, casting spells, opening/closing/browsing the shop, confirming a selection during a selection screen, and clicking to spectate other teams or return the camera during combat downtime all count as activity.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Moving the mouse, using any spell (without casting), taking damage, and being teleported across the different phases do not count as activity.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: During bye rounds or after elimination while spectating, AFK detection is disabled for the duration.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: After 180 seconds of inactivity, the inactive player's ally can surrender to exit the game safely during the shop phase, eliminating their team by themselves.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: After 300 seconds of inactivity, the inactive player's client quits automatically.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Instated AFK/Leaver detections and punishments.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: After 70 seconds of inactivity, the AFK warning will appear on the player's screen.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Issuing move, attack, casting spells, opening/closing/browsing the shop, confirming a selection during a selection screen, and clicking to spectate other teams or return the camera during combat downtime all count as activity.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Moving the mouse, using any spell (without casting), taking damage, and being teleported across the different phases do not count as activity.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: During bye rounds or after elimination while spectating, AFK detection is disabled for the duration.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: After 180 seconds of inactivity, the inactive player's ally can surrender to exit the game safely during the shop phase, eliminating their team by themselves.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: After 300 seconds of inactivity, the inactive player's client quits automatically.
